item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 07/Jul/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The subtropical ridge will weaken slightly today and tomorrow. There will be a few showers but very hot over the coast of southern China. The upper-air disturbances are expected to bring showers and thunderstorms to the coast of southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea midweek this week. A southerly airstream will affect southern China gradually in the latter part of this week, it will remain very hot over the region.

Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers. Isolated thunderstorms in the morning. Very hot with sunny periods during the day.
Temp range: 28 - 33 C
R.H. range: 65 - 90 per Cent
